create_MidasNet: create a MidasNet model for monocular depth estimation with resnext101_wsl backbone
run_MidasNet_forward: run the MidasNet forward pass on an input image tensor to predict depth
review_MidasNet_init: review the MidasNet initialization with configurable features and non_negative output options
refactor_MidasNet_output_conv: refactor the MidasNet output convolution layers to change the depth prediction head
summarize_MidasNet_forward: summarize the MidasNet forward pass that extracts features through four encoder layers and refines them
